---
title: "What is the probability of at least k successes?"
---

## What the question asks

What is the probability of at least k successes?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Identify n, p and minimum k.

2. Calculate P(X > k-1) with pbinom(k-1,n,p,lower.tail=FALSE).

3. Explain the inclusive boundary.

## Runnable example

```{r}
n <- 10; p <- 0.3; k <- 5
answer <- pbinom(k-1,size=n,prob=p,lower.tail=FALSE)
print(answer)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(answer,sum(dbinom(k:n,n,p)))))
```

## Interpret the result

The result is the chance of five or more successes. The expression adds probabilities for 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 successes.

## Check before using your own data

Use k-1 as the cutoff for 1-P(X <= k-1). Using k would answer a different question.
